purpose: One private, prioritized, nonsecret execution packet for the remaining launch-critical owner and qualified-review actions.

requestSummaries.ownerAction: Authorize or configure a legitimate functioning npm registry and vulnerability-audit path in the approved secure environment.
requestSummaries.where: Approved npm configuration or organization registry console
requestSummaries.safeConfirmation: Return the nonsecret registry scope/project identifier and confirmation that test access is configured.
requestSummaries.builderVerification: Run fresh npm ci, audit and PostgreSQL acceptance; record provider receipts and rollback.
requestSummaries.rollback: Revoke configuration and retain dependency-independent fallback; keep production gates closed.

requestSummaries.ownerAction: Supply or authorize access to only the exact portal artifact selected for the next D4 pair and the named staging configuration.
requestSummaries.where: Dedicated portal builder artifact handoff and staging provider
requestSummaries.safeConfirmation: Return exact artifact filename/SHA and nonsecret staging deployment identifier.
requestSummaries.rollback: Disconnect boundary and restore exact last-known-good projections.

requestSummaries.ownerAction: Arrange dated authoritative resource review and qualified survivor-safety review for the exact dedicated portal artifact.
requestSummaries.where: Dedicated Domestic Violence Aid review workflow
requestSummaries.mustNotPaste: survivor narratives, safe-contact choices, confidential locations
requestSummaries.safeConfirmation: Return reviewer role, review date, exact artifact identity and pass/fail receipt without confidential content.
requestSummaries.builderVerification: Validate central routing, support, analytics, suppression and incident boundaries against the accepted receipt.
requestSummaries.rollback: Keep routing closed or revert to safe static emergency guidance.

requestSummaries.capability: Real-device, assistive-technology, QR, print and domain acceptance
requestSummaries.ownerAction: Arrange the named real-device and assistive-technology acceptance session after the exact candidate is available.
requestSummaries.where: Phone, tablet, laptop, screen reader, camera scan, printer and supported browsers
requestSummaries.mustNotPaste: private account data or live legal matters
requestSummaries.safeConfirmation: Return device/browser matrix and signed pass/fail receipt tied to exact candidate SHA.
requestSummaries.builderVerification: Reproduce reported defects, record fixes, rerun affected suite and invalidate stale evidence.
requestSummaries.rollback: Do not distribute materials; use local demonstration only.

requestSummaries.capability: Production database, email, MFA, monitoring, backup and restore
requestSummaries.ownerAction: Configure approved services in secure stores after provider/project choices are accepted.
requestSummaries.where: Approved hosting, database, email, identity and monitoring consoles
requestSummaries.mustNotPaste: passwords, API keys, SMTP credentials, database URLs, recovery codes
requestSummaries.safeConfirmation: Return nonsecret project IDs, service URLs and configuration-complete receipts.
requestSummaries.builderVerification: Run readiness, migration, email, MFA, monitoring, backup, restore and incident drills.
requestSummaries.rollback: Revoke credentials, restore last-known-good configuration and keep sensitive writes closed.

requestSummaries.capability: Legal, privacy, terms, support, incident and owner launch acceptance
requestSummaries.ownerAction: Name qualified reviewers and decide the exact capability scope only after technical evidence is complete.
requestSummaries.where: Versioned review and owner receipt workflow
requestSummaries.mustNotPaste: privileged advice, confidential user data, secrets
requestSummaries.safeConfirmation: Return scoped review receipts and owner decision IDs tied to exact artifact/environment.
requestSummaries.builderVerification: Verify conditions, expiration, revocation and acceptance freeze before deployment.
requestSummaries.rollback: Keep NO_GO or roll back affected capability.

requestSummaries.ownerAction: Approve exact pilot plan, price, discounts, seat rules, terms and sandbox project when ready.
requestSummaries.where: Owner decision register and Stripe test console
requestSummaries.safeConfirmation: Return approved plan IDs/decision receipt and nonsecret sandbox project ID.
requestSummaries.builderVerification: Test checkout, signed/idempotent webhooks, entitlements, cancellation, refunds, chargebacks and reconciliation.
requestSummaries.rollback: Pause billing and revoke entitlements without changing profile facts.

requestSummaries.ownerAction: Select and securely configure an approved provider only after data-flow/privacy/security/legal review.
requestSummaries.where: Approved provider console and secret store
requestSummaries.mustNotPaste: API keys, private documents, user matters
requestSummaries.safeConfirmation: Return nonsecret project/model identifier and sandbox configuration receipt.
requestSummaries.builderVerification: Run tenant isolation, redaction, retention, failure, fallback, cost, abuse and rollback acceptance.
requestSummaries.rollback: Disable provider kill switch and use deterministic fallback.

requestSummaries.capability: Binding $15 monthly professional and firm membership test-mode acceptance
requestSummaries.environment: Stripe test mode and named staging
requestSummaries.ownerAction: Create or confirm three Stripe test-mode monthly price objects matching the accepted manifest and configure the signed webhook in the approved secure environment.
requestSummaries.where: Approved Stripe test workspace and secure environment store
requestSummaries.mustNotPaste: Stripe secret keys, webhook signing secrets, customer payment data
requestSummaries.safeConfirmation: Return only nonsecret Stripe product/price IDs, test project identifier, webhook endpoint identifier and configuration-complete receipt.
requestSummaries.builderVerification: Run test checkout, signed/idempotent webhook, duplicate-payer, payer-transfer, cancellation, refund, chargeback, reconciliation, receipt and rollback acceptance.
requestSummaries.rollback: Disable test prices/webhook, revoke configuration and keep public checkout/live billing closed.

requestSummaries.capability: GitHub and Render provider binding for read-only remote deployment doctor
requestSummaries.ownerAction: Authorize the approved GitHub repository connection and Render workspace access, or provide only the nonsecret repository and service identifiers.
requestSummaries.where: GitHub and Render authorization screens; never in a public issue or source file.
requestSummaries.mustNotPaste: OAuth tokens, deploy hooks, API keys, passwords, secret values, database URLs
requestSummaries.safeConfirmation: Confirm the connection is authorized and return only nonsecret repository/workspace/service identifiers.
requestSummaries.builderVerification: Run the read-only remote deployment doctor, verify allow-listed targets and secret presence states, and record the onboarding receipt.
requestSummaries.rollback: Revoke the connection or remove the allow-list; production remains unchanged.
